newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai per capita GDP seen at $3,000 this year.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai per capita GDP seen at $3,000 this year.

text.p: China's booming city of Shanghai expects its per capita gross domestic product (GDP) to top $3,000 this year, the China Securities said on Tuesday.

The city's per capita GDP is seen reaching $5,000 in the year 2000, the newspaper quoted Xiao Lin, deputy director of the Comprehensive Economic Office of the Shanghai Planning Commission as telling an international seminar.
By the end of the century, the proportion of the service industry in GDP would rise to 48 percent from the present 42 percent, Xiao said but gave no further details.
